text:
alex_support: FYI - Nyx Labs (nyx-342) onboarding blocked. Ingest job throwing validation error during sample upload. Customer has onboarding call tomorrow; this is a trial with 6 seats. Marking as potential renewal-risk if not fixed quickly. Error: 'validation failed: user_id must be string'.

maya_cs: Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the failing request & SDK version? I'll prep a short comms note for the customer and standby for a workaround offer.

alex_support: Payload below. Using node SDK v2.0.8. ```POST /v1/ingest/sample
{
  "user_id": {"uuid": 98765},
  "metadata": {"role": "tester"}
}```

nina_se: Assigning to me. Quick hypothesis: some clients are nesting id objects instead of sending plain string ids. We can either relax validation (accept object and extract .uuid) or add coercion at the ingestion edge. I'll try a minimal coercion patch first. ETA 2-4h depending on CI/canary.

jordi_csm: I'll triage customer comms and escalation path. If >4h, we notify AE + Solutions and offer demo reschedule. Also adding renewal-watch.

alex_support: Customer contact (sarah@nyxlabs.com) asked for ETA and whether test data can be ingested manually. They can apply a quick client-side stringify but they'd prefer server fix.

nina_se: Pushed branch ingest-accept-object-nyx342. Running unit tests now. If clean, request staging canary.

deploybot: provisioning staging env for nyx-342: nyx-342-stg created. Running smoke tests.

nina_se: Unit tests passed. Triggered canary deploy to staging.

deploybot: canary: 3/3 smoke checks PASS on staging. No schema regressions flagged.

nina_se: Canary looks good. We're merging to main and scheduling a 5% prod rollout in 10m. Will watch error rate and validation metrics.

maya_cs: Draft customer message for approval: "Hi Sarah — we traced the ingestion failure to an edge case where nested id objects are rejected. We're rolling a targeted fix now; expected rollout within 3 hours. Short-term workaround: stringify the id on the client or upload using our temp ingest endpoint /v1/ingest/temp-nyx-342. Will follow up once rollout is verified. — Maya"

jordi_csm: Add a line offering to join/demo with CS during the next session and to reschedule if preferred. I'll log renewal-watch and prepare the AE note.

alex_support: Sent workaround + temp endpoint to Sarah. She replied: "We can stringify but would prefer a server fix. Demo still scheduled but paused until ingest works."

nina_se: Merge complete. Prod canary started. Monitoring: validation-failures for nyx-342 dropped to 0 in canary.

deploybot: prod-canary: 2 instances healthy. No increase in latency.

nina_se: Rolling to 5% prod now. Watching metrics for 30m.

maya_cs: Scheduled check-ins: +2h update to customer, +4h follow-up and AE brief if still open. Jordi 94 please add renewal flag to CRM and draft escalation note for AE.

jordi_csm: Renewal flag set. AE note drafted and pinned to account timeline. If unresolved by EOD we'll escalate to CRO.

alex_support: Customer confirmed temporary endpoint ingestion succeeded. They will test again after 5% rollout.

nina_se: 5% rollout shows no issues; increasing to 25%. Validation failures remain suppressed. ETA to full rollout ~1h.

maya_cs: Sending customer update now (short): "Fix is rolling out; we see successful ingestion from your temp endpoint. Expect full availability within 1 hour. We'll call to confirm post-rollout. — Maya"

jordi_csm: Thanks. I'll add a postmortem action item to update SDK docs to warn about nested ids and add a migration note. Also capture feedback for product re: stricter/looser validation policy.

alex_support: Customer replied: "Thanks — will hold demo after you confirm. Appreciate the quick turnaround."

nina_se: Full rollout complete. Monitoring OK. Closing rollout ticket and will revert coercion after a week if no regressions and after SDK migration guidance published.

maya_cs: Confirming with customer that demo can proceed. Will post a short retrospective in #enablement and close this thread. Great cross-team response. :tada:
